title: Why Is There a Cleaning Fee?
observable_outcome: The learner contrasts a written booking term with an added fee, asks for an explanation, and confirms the corrected total.
learning_objective: Ask a hotel to explain an unexpected cleaning fee, compare it with the written booking terms, and confirm whether it will be removed.

scenario.setting: A fictional apartment-hotel reception desk at checkout.
scenario.prompt: Your booking confirmation says: Total €210. Cleaning included. Your checkout bill says: Total €245, including a €35 cleaning fee.
scenario.puzzle: Which words are the strongest evidence, what should you ask, and what total should you confirm if the fee is removed?
scenario.privacy_note: The hotel, booking, bill, staff member, and customer are fictional teaching data. This activity is language practice, not legal or financial advice.

model.clarify: My booking confirmation says cleaning is included, but this bill adds a €35 cleaning fee.
model.customer_reply: Could you explain why this fee was added? Could you check the written booking terms and remove the fee if it was included?
model.confirm: So the €35 fee will be removed and the corrected total will be €210, right?
model.neutral_variant: The confirmation says cleaning is included. Could you check why the bill includes an extra €35 fee?

language_focus.grammar: In the direct question Why was this fee added?, the order is question word + auxiliary verb + subject. After Could you explain ..., the embedded question uses statement order: why this fee was added, not why was this fee added.
language_focus.meaning: Included means already part of the stated total. An added fee is a separate amount placed on the bill. Corrected total means the new total after an agreed change.
language_focus.appropriateness: Name the exact written term and amount, contrast them with but, and ask for an explanation before requesting a change. This is clear without accusing the listener.
language_focus.detail_language: Written booking terms are useful evidence in this fictional exchange. Real hotel policies, consumer rights, taxes, and mandatory charges vary by provider and location.

choice_activity.prompt: Which evidence best supports your question about the fee?

options.text: The confirmation says cleaning is included, but the bill adds a €35 cleaning fee.
options.feedback: Correct. It compares the exact written term with the exact added amount.
Comfort does not explain the fee. Use the written words cleaning included and the €35 bill line.
The total matters, but it does not show the conflict by itself. Compare cleaning included with the €35 cleaning fee.

request_activity.prompt: Which question is clear, calm, and grammatically well formed?

options.text: Could you explain why this fee was added?
options.feedback: Correct. The embedded question uses statement order: why this fee was added.

options.text: Could you explain why was this fee added?
options.feedback: After Could you explain, use statement order: why this fee was added.

options.text: You added a fake fee. Remove it now.
options.feedback: This accuses the listener and skips the evidence. State the written term and ask for an explanation first.

slot_activity.prompt: Match each detail to its job in the request.

feedback.written term: Correct. These are the key words in the confirmation.
feedback.requested action: The requested action is explain and remove if included.

feedback.written term: The written term is cleaning included.
feedback.added fee: Correct. This is the separate cleaning fee on the bill.
feedback.requested action: The requested action is explain and remove if included.

feedback.written term: The written term is cleaning included.
feedback.corrected total: Correct. This is €245 minus the €35 fee.
feedback.requested action: The requested action is explain and remove if included.

feedback.written term: The written term is cleaning included.
feedback.requested action: Correct. This asks for a reason and a conditional resolution.

production_task.scenario: An airport hotel confirmation says shuttle included and shows a total of €160. The checkout bill is €178 because it adds an €18 shuttle fee.
production_task.instruction: Write one sentence that compares the written term with the bill. Ask why the fee was added, request a check, and confirm the corrected total.
acceptable_responses: My confirmation says the shuttle is included, but this bill adds an €18 shuttle fee. Could you explain why it was added and check the booking terms? So the corrected total will be €160, right?
The booking says shuttle included. Could you check why the bill includes an extra €18 and remove it if it was included? Will the new total be €160?
rubric: I quoted or paraphrased the written term.
I named the added fee and amount.
I asked for an explanation or check without accusing anyone.
production_task.valid_variants: Can you explain ...? and Could you explain ...? are both possible; could is more formal and polite. Why was the fee added? is a valid direct question. After explain, use why the fee was added.

review_prompt: Tomorrow, recall the four request slots: written term, added fee, requested action, and corrected total. Make one calm request using all four.

design.reference_limit: The reference title/page was verified earlier. Full playback and frames were not inspected. No artwork, characters, music, footage, or software dependency was copied.
design.texture: Restrained fibres and speckles generated procedurally.
design.depth: Documents, term tabs, fee cards, speech pieces, totals, characters, and arrows use cream cut edges, overlap, and offset shadows.
design.motion_principle: The confirmation opens; the bill slides over it; the written term and fee align; a question card unfolds; the €35 card lifts away while the total pivots to €210; the shuttle transfer scene repeats the evidence pattern. Captions remain fixed.
design.accessibility: Dark navy text on cream panels; every colour-coded term, fee, total, and action also has a word label and distinct shape.

visual.title: Written term, fee, question, total
visual.alt_text: A colourful layered papercut evidence path. A booking confirmation says cleaning included and €210. A checkout bill adds a €35 cleaning fee and totals €245. Arrows lead to ask why, request a check, remove the fee if included, and confirm €210.
visual.prose: First find the exact written term in the confirmation. Compare it with the separate fee and amount on the bill. Ask why the fee was added and request a check. If the fee is removed, confirm the corrected total.
